matrix.basis: Attached SIC17_MO-104.xlsx start and end columns
Existing culvert format and location policy
Existing start/end capture policy; applies to surveyed extent, not a claim that each individual safety object is linear
Existing informative catalogue POSTES DE KILOMETRAJE and user requirement

matrix.capture: Historic read/edit only; no new type codes

historicalEndLocations: Hidden end fields on SIC-22 are ignored during new capture validation but are preserved when an existing record is edited. No historical SQL updates.

signalIdentification.CATALOG: Existing contractual code selected by search; Informativa subtype Hito / poste kilométrico selects existing I-2A, typeCode 3, and captures kilometerPostNumber in the existing contractual number column
signalIdentification.MANUAL: Unlisted code with operator description; cannot reuse an existing catalogue code
signalIdentification.UNIDENTIFIABLE: Null signalCode with optional observation; never fabricate a contractual code
signalIdentification.completion: SignalIdentificationPolicy.completionPending(state or Sic22Entity) flags missing or mismatched code, manual description and marker number at final/export review. UNIDENTIFIABLE has no required fake code.
signalIdentification.CORE_metadata: signalCodeSource, signalDescription and signalObservation are persisted in Room and available to CORE. No new contractual SIC22 workbook columns are invented.
